scholarships.title: Ghana Government Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Ghanaian citizens with WASSCE aggregate 8 or better
scholarships.description: Full scholarship for undergraduate studies in Ghanaian public universities

scholarships.title: President's STEM Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: STEM-focused students with WASSCE Aggregate 10 or better
scholarships.description: Supporting students pursuing Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics

scholarships.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
scholarships.eligibility: Academically talented students with leadership potential
scholarships.coverage: Full tuition, mentorship, and leadership development
scholarships.description: Empowering the next generation of African leaders

scholarships.title: Kofi Annan Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Students committed to peace and sustainable development
scholarships.description: Honoring Kofi Annan's legacy of excellence and service

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarships - Ghana
scholarships.eligibility: Graduates with leadership potential and minimum GPA of 3.5
scholarships.coverage: Full tuition, living expenses, and travel to UK
scholarships.description: UK government's international awards program for future leaders

scholarships.title: DAAD Ghana Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Students with strong academic record and research potential
scholarships.coverage: Full tuition, living expenses, and travel to Germany
scholarships.description: Supporting academic and research collaboration with Germany

scholarships.title: Federal Government Scholarship (Federal Scholarship Board)
scholarships.eligibility: Nigerian citizens enrolled full-time at a Federal or State university with a minimum CGPA of 3.0/5.0 (undergraduate track); the Bilateral Education Agreement (BEA) track additionally requires 7 WAEC/NECO distinctions for study abroad
scholarships.coverage: Tuition support and stipend; the BEA track funds study at partner universities abroad for top performers
scholarships.deadline: Announced annually - check the official portal for the current cycle
scholarships.description: Nigeria's national undergraduate and postgraduate scholarship scheme, administered by the Federal Scholarship Board

scholarships.title: PTDF Undergraduate Scholarship Scheme
scholarships.eligibility: Nigerian undergraduates in their 2nd year (200 level) at a Nigerian public university, studying a PTDF-sponsored course (mainly sciences, engineering, and geosciences)
scholarships.coverage: Tuition, upkeep allowance, and book allowance for the remainder of the degree
scholarships.deadline: Announced annually - check the official PTDF scholarship portal
scholarships.description: Supports Nigerian students pursuing science, engineering, and technology degrees relevant to the oil and gas sector

scholarships.title: NNPC/TotalEnergies National Merit Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: First (100L) or second-year (200L) full-time undergraduates at an NUC-accredited Nigerian university, any course of study
scholarships.coverage: Annual scholarship grant renewed until completion of the undergraduate programme
scholarships.deadline: Announced annually - check the official application portal
scholarships.description: Merit-based scholarship supporting Nigerian undergraduates across all fields of study

scholarships.title: MTN Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduates in Nigerian public universities, polytechnics, and colleges of education - categories include Science & Technology (300 level), Medicine (400 level), and Blind Students
scholarships.coverage: Tuition, textbooks, and living expense support
scholarships.description: Annual scholarship supporting high-performing Nigerian students in public tertiary institutions; the 2026 cycle has closed - a new cycle is expected in 2027

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarships - Nigeria
scholarships.eligibility: Nigerian graduates with at least 2,800 hours (~2 years) of work experience, applying for a one-year UK master's degree
scholarships.coverage: Full tuition, living expenses, and travel to the UK
scholarships.description: UK government's international awards programme for future leaders, open to Nigerian applicants

scholarships.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program - Pan-Atlantic University
scholarships.eligibility: Academically talented Nigerian (African Union citizen) students admitted to Pan-Atlantic University, Nigeria's Mastercard Foundation partner institution
scholarships.coverage: Full tuition, accommodation, and leadership development support
scholarships.deadline: Set by Pan-Atlantic University's own admissions cycle - apply for admission first
scholarships.description: Empowering the next generation of African leaders; Pan-Atlantic University is the first and only Nigerian partner institution
